ownership.statement: Under the Hardware Usage Terms all Hardware remains Zscaler's property during and after the Subscription Term, and the customer may not sell, lease, transfer or repurpose it or let a third party use it.

quotes: All Hardware is and shall remain the property of Zscaler during and after the Subscription Term.
You shall not sell, lease, transfer, or repurpose the Hardware, or permit any third party to use the Hardware for any purpose.

restrictions.statement: The terms prohibit loading software other than that provided or authorized by Zscaler, physical alterations, self-repair except as instructed, reverse engineering, access by persons other than Zscaler or Zscaler-authorized agents without Zscaler's prior written consent, and relocation without prior written approval.

quotes: Load, install, or run any software on the Hardware other than software provided or authorized by Zscaler;
Without Zscaler's prior written consent, permit any person other than Zscaler or Zscaler-authorized agents to access, open, or service the Hardware; or
Make any physical alterations or additions to the Hardware;
Attempt to repair, service, or maintain the Hardware except as expressly instructed by Zscaler;
Reverse engineer, disassemble, or decompile the Hardware or any software therein;
Relocate the Hardware from one physical location to another without prior written approval from Zscaler.

obligations.statement: The customer must appoint at least one technical representative with physical access, and must, at its expense, maintain the Hardware in an environment meeting Zscaler's operating conditions and provide continuous power with surge protection.

quotes: You shall appoint at least one technical representative with physical access to the Hardware
You shall, at your expense:
Maintain the Hardware in an environment that meets Zscaler's operating conditions for the applicable Hardware
Provide continuous, uninterrupted power supply to the Hardware with suitable surge protection.

capacity.statement: If Zscaler determines traffic or usage exceeds Hardware capacity, the customer must within thirty (30) days of notification accommodate additional or upgraded Hardware or take action to reduce utilization in accordance with Zscaler's guidance.

quotes: If Zscaler determines that your traffic or usage exceeds Hardware capacity, you shall, within thirty (30) days of notification, accommodate additional or upgraded Hardware or take action to reduce utilization in accordance with Zscaler's guidance

replacement.statement: If Hardware fails or becomes defective during the Subscription Term, Zscaler provides advance replacement Hardware subject to availability, shipped within one (1) to three (3) business days of confirming the failure; on receipt of the replacement the customer returns the defective Hardware within thirty (30) calendar days.

quotes: If Hardware fails or becomes defective during the Subscription Term
Zscaler shall provide advance replacement Hardware, subject to availability.
Zscaler will ship replacement Hardware within one (1) to three (3) business days of confirming the failure.
Upon receipt of replacement Hardware, you shall return defective Hardware to Zscaler within thirty (30) calendar days

termination-return.statement: On termination or expiration of the Subscription Term all Hardware must be returned within twenty-one (21) calendar days; Zscaler bears return shipping cost and may invoice the replacement value if Hardware is not returned within twenty-one (21) calendar days; where return is not cost-effective, Zscaler may instruct disposal, with a Certificate of Destruction and disposal costs borne by the customer.

quotes: you shall return all Hardware to Zscaler within twenty-one (21) calendar days.
Zscaler shall bear the cost of return shipping.
If you fail to return Hardware within twenty-one (21) calendar days of termination or expiration, Zscaler may invoice you for the replacement value of such Hardware
In cases where return is not cost-effective due to the age of the Hardware or shipping costs, Zscaler may instruct you to dispose of the Hardware
You shall provide Zscaler with a Certificate of Destruction and shall bear any costs associated with such disposal.

evaluation.statement: Hardware provided for evaluation, proof of concept, or trial purposes must be returned within twenty-one (21) calendar days after the evaluation period ends or converted to a paid production subscription before it ends.

quotes: If Hardware was provided for evaluation, proof of concept, or trial purposes
return the Hardware to Zscaler within twenty-one (21) calendar days following the end of the evaluation period
convert to a paid production subscription for the applicable Zscaler service before the end of the evaluation period

data-removal.statement: The customer is responsible for removing all data from Hardware before returning or disposing of it; Zscaler is not responsible for the security or return of data remaining on Hardware returned to or disposed of by the customer.

quotes: You are responsible for removing all data from Hardware prior to returning or disposing of the Hardware.
Zscaler is not responsible for the security or return of any data remaining on Hardware returned to or disposed of by you.

sla.statement: Failure to comply with any obligation under the Hardware Usage Terms, including the Product-Specific Hardware Terms, results in invalidation of related Service Level Agreements for the affected Zscaler service.

quotes: Your failure to comply with any obligation under these Hardware Usage Terms, including the applicable Product-Specific Hardware Terms, shall result in the invalidation of any and all related Service Level Agreements for the affected Zscaler service.

zia.statement: For ZIA appliances the customer must keep at least two Hardware units per installation location, internet connectivity through at least two discrete ISPs, and staff available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week; Zscaler Cloud Operations manages configuration and operation.

quotes: You shall maintain no fewer than two (2) Hardware units per installation location.
no fewer than two (2) discrete internet service providers with redundant capabilities at each installation location
You shall ensure that personnel capable of responding to Zscaler requests and providing physical access to the Hardware are available 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.
Zscaler Cloud Operations will manage the configuration and ongoing operation of the Hardware.

zia-repair.statement: For ZIA appliances (Section A.7) the repair and replacement process for the Hardware is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations, and Zscaler coordinates replacement directly with the customer in accordance with the procedures described in the applicable support documentation.

quotes: A.7. Repair and Replacement. The repair and replacement process for the Hardware is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations. Zscaler will coordinate replacement directly with you in accordance with the procedures described in the applicable support documentation.

ztb.statement: For Zero Trust Branch appliances (Section B) the customer must keep personnel with physical access available 24/7, give Zscaler remote connectivity access, and do the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable); the technical representative must be trained at the customer's expense.

quotes: B.1. 24/7 Availability. You shall ensure personnel with physical access to the Hardware are available to respond to Zscaler requests 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.
B.2. Technical Representative Training. Your technical representative shall be fully trained, at your expense
B.3. Remote Connectivity. You shall provide Zscaler with remote connectivity access to the Hardware for management and troubleshooting purposes.
B.4. Customer Setup. You are responsible for the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable) of the Hardware

zpa-appliance.statement: For ZPA appliances (Section C) the customer must keep personnel with physical access available 24/7, give Zscaler remote connectivity access, and do the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable); the technical representative must be trained at the customer's expense.

quotes: C.1. 24/7 Availability. You shall ensure personnel with physical access to the Hardware are available to respond to Zscaler requests 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.
C.2. Technical Representative Training. Your technical representative shall be fully trained, at your expense
C.3. Remote Connectivity. You shall provide Zscaler with remote connectivity access to the Hardware for management and troubleshooting purposes.
C.4. Customer Setup. You are responsible for the physical setup and rack-mounting (if applicable) of the Hardware

precedence.statement: In the event of a conflict, the Product-Specific Hardware Terms control for the applicable Hardware.

quotes: In the event of a conflict, the Product-Specific Hardware Terms control for the applicable Hardware.

rma-start.statement: The RMA page says its RMA Process and Policy applies to all Zscaler Hardware and starts with a support ticket in the Zscaler Support Portal; Hardware must not be returned until an RMA is issued.

quotes: This RMA Process and Policy applies to all Zscaler Hardware.
To initiate the Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) process, submit a support ticket via the Zscaler Support Portal.
Do not return any Hardware until an RMA is issued.

rma-info.statement: Zscaler Support works with the customer to troubleshoot and diagnose issues remotely, and if the issue cannot be resolved remotely or is determined to be a Hardware fault, Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware; to continue the RMA process Zscaler Support requests company name, Org ID, shipping address, contact details, and product model, serial and asset tag numbers, then creates an RMA number and ships a replacement device.

quotes: Zscaler Support works with you to troubleshoot and diagnose issues remotely.
If the issue cannot be resolved remotely or is determined to be a Hardware fault, Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware.
Company Name
Organization ID (Org ID)
Shipping Address
Contact name, phone number, and email address
Product model, serial, and asset tag numbers
Creates an RMA number for tracking purposes.
Ships a replacement device to you.

rma-return.statement: The customer must package and ship the defective device to Zscaler within 30 calendar days of receiving the replacement; a return label is included in most cases, and returned items must have a valid RMA number.

quotes: You must package the defective device and ship it to Zscaler within 30 calendar days of receiving the replacement device.
A return shipping label is included with the replacement device in most cases.
All returned items must have a valid Zscaler RMA number.

rma-complete.statement: The RMA process is complete after the replacement device is installed and operational and Zscaler receives the defective device.

quotes: The RMA process is complete after the replacement device is successfully installed and operational and Zscaler receives the defective device.

replacement-obligation.summary: The Hardware Usage Terms say Zscaler shall provide advance replacement Hardware when Hardware fails during the Subscription Term, while the RMA page says that if the issue cannot be resolved remotely or is a Hardware fault, Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware.

positions.says: Zscaler shall provide advance replacement Hardware, subject to availability.

quotes: Zscaler shall provide advance replacement Hardware, subject to availability.

positions.says: Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware after remote troubleshooting.

quotes: Zscaler might decide to replace the Hardware.

replacement-obligation.impact: Whether replacement is an obligation after a confirmed failure or a Zscaler decision after troubleshooting is not stated; the RMA page is a process description and does not say it limits the terms.

rma-scope-zia.summary: The RMA page says its process applies to all Zscaler Hardware and starts with a support ticket, while the Hardware Usage Terms say the repair and replacement process for ZIA appliances is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations, and that Product-Specific Hardware Terms control on conflict.

positions.says: The RMA Process and Policy applies to all Zscaler Hardware.

quotes: This RMA Process and Policy applies to all Zscaler Hardware.

positions.says: For ZIA appliances, repair and replacement is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations, and Product-Specific Hardware Terms control on conflict.

quotes: A.7. Repair and Replacement. The repair and replacement process for the Hardware is managed by Zscaler Cloud Operations.
In the event of a conflict, the Product-Specific Hardware Terms control for the applicable Hardware.

rma-scope-zia.impact: For a ZIA appliance the pages do not say whether the support-ticket RMA steps or the Cloud Operations process governs a replacement.

undefined-conditions.title: What "useful life advised by Zscaler" and "Zscaler's operating conditions" are
undefined-conditions.detail: The Hardware Usage Terms refer to a useful life advised by Zscaler (exclusion 8.1c) and to Zscaler's operating conditions for the applicable Hardware, but the captured page gives neither a value. For ZPA appliances, operating temperature, humidity and power values are in zpa.software-components.appliance, which this page does not cite as Zscaler's operating conditions.
